summary: Completed frontend testing for new features: Landing page, Digest page, Spanish supplier emails, Late credit, and Mobile responsive. Most features working correctly. Critical issue: Approve-all button not functioning, blocking Threads and second payment flow testing.

integration_issues.issue: Approve all (4) button click does not trigger API call or create threads. Actions remain in 'Draft' status after clicking. This blocks testing of Threads page, second payment flow, and digest with open offers.
integration_issues.impact: Blocks entire payroll gap workflow - users cannot approve actions to start conversations with counterparties

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Approve-all button on Plan page. Button click does not trigger /api/actions/approve-all endpoint or actions remain in draft status. This blocks the entire payroll gap workflow including: (1) Threads creation, (2) Second payment flow testing, (3) Digest showing open offers. Verify the approve-all API endpoint is working and that the frontend is correctly calling it with origin_url parameter. After fix, need to retest: Digest with 4 open offers, Second payment flow (Johnson's $3,100 second payment), and Threads page functionality.
